hero.heading: Presidential Suite
hero.tagline: The ultimate expression of Caribbean luxury

overview.body1: The Presidential Suite is the pinnacle of the Stonetrail Villas experience — a private king bedroom, a dedicated sitting room, a dressing area, and bespoke concierge service that anticipates your every need.
overview.body2: Reserved for guests who demand the very best, the Presidential Suite offers an unmatched level of privacy, comfort, and personalised service in the heart of St. Vincent and the Grenadines.
